course: DE 401: Capstone - The LLM Data Backbone
context: Pure judgment synthesis of the whole curriculum - scenario-heavy. End-to-end architecture (source -> ingestion -> lake -> feature store -> index -> RAG endpoint; batch vs streaming paths; component contracts; source-of-truth vs derived copies); observability (freshness SLAs and lag, production hit rate/MRR/reranker score monitoring, golden query sets as regression canaries, triaging quality drops: data drift vs index defect vs model change); cost engineering (hot/cold tiering, precompute vs compute-on-read, quantization recall-per-dollar, re-embedding cadence); the re-embedding/backfill playbook (rebuild-and-swap with versioned aliases, shadow index validation gates, incremental vs full backfill triggers, rollback and mixed-version serving risks); scenario diagnosis (symptom-to-layer triage, latency budget breakdown, defending design choices under constraints). Ground everything in realistic incident narratives with numbers.

topics: Source-to-Serving Data Flow: Ingestion to Lake to Feature Store to Index to RAG Endpoint

03 Cost and Compute Tradeoff Engineering: Hot vs Cold Storage Tiering for Corpora and Indexes, Precompute vs Compute-on-Read: The Decision Framework, Quantization and Index Compression: Recall per Dollar, Re-embedding Cadence: When Quality Gains Justify Rebuilds

04 The Re-embedding and Backfill Playbook: Index Rebuild-and-Swap with Versioned Aliases, Shadow Index Validation Before Cutover, Incremental vs Full Backfill Triggers and Idempotent Replay, Rollback Design and Mixed-Version Serving Risks

05 Scenario Diagnosis and Design Review: Symptom-to-Layer Triage: Mapping Failures to Pipeline Stages, Latency Budget Breakdown: Retrieval, Rerank, Generation, Design Review Defense: Justifying Choices Under Constraints
